# SubSentry

> AI-powered subscription management. Track what you're actually paying
> for, catch duplicate or overpriced subscriptions, and add new
> subscriptions by describing them in plain English instead of filling
> out a form.

SubSentry helps people see every subscription they're paying for in one
place, flags likely duplicates and cost outliers using deterministic
rules run against their own real transaction/subscription data (never a
guessed or fabricated figure), and supports importing subscriptions from
a bank CSV or a live bank connection.
